ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage concentrated near the peduncle and lower lobe margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Focal high-contrast white mottling at the peduncle insertion zone; irregular white clusters on the interior of both lobes; distinct white banding along the posterior distal edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge of the right lobe; irregular, high-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys on the distal margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep trajectory on the right lobe lobes; moderate convex curve on the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) located on the distal tip of the left lobe and along the trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular tissue disruption and jagged contouring on the distal margin of the left lobe; visible epibiotic colonization on lobe extremities.
